content:
The datasheet defines two orderable SKUs (SO-SFP-10GE-LR and SO-SFP-10GE-LR-I) with the same optical and protocol specs; only operating temperature differs. Transmit wavelength 1270–1355 nm and receiver wavelength 1260–1565 nm apply to both SKUs together (not separate selectable modes). Grouping uses the transmit pair for `wavelength_min_nm` / `wavelength_max_nm` with the product’s 1310 nm nominal TX focus; protocols and bit rates are shared per SKU.
